function use(cb: ((x: string) => number) | ((x: number) => string)) { console.log(cb); }
use((x) => 1);
const f: ((x: number) => number) | ((x: number) => string) = (x) => x + 1;
const g: ((x: number) => number) | ((x: string) => string) = (x) => 1;
const h: ((x: number, y?: string) => number) | ((x: number) => string) = (x) => 1;
const i: ((x: number) => number) | ((x: number, y: string) => string) = (x) => 1;
const j: ((x: number) => number) | ((x: number, y: string) => string) = (x, y) => 1;
const k: ((x: number) => number) | ((x: number) => string) | undefined = (x) => x;
const l: ((x: number) => number) | ((x: number) => string) = (x) => true;
const a: { (x: string): void; (x: number): void } = (x) => { const t: string = x; };
const b: { (x: string): void; (x: number, y: number): void } = (x) => { const t: string = x; };
const c: ((x: string) => void) & ((x: number) => void) = (x) => { const t: string = x; };
const d: ((x: any) => number) | ((x: number) => string) = (x) => 1;
const e: (<T>(x: T) => T) | (<T>(x: T) => T) = (x) => x;
const m: ((x: number) => void) | { (x: number): void; (x: number, y: string): void } = (x) => {};
const n: ((x: number) => void) | { (x: number): void; (x: string, y: string): void } = (x, y) => {};
const o: ((...a: number[]) => void) | ((...b: number[]) => number) = (x) => {};
